title: London Guernica 3 Days
description: Framed mixed-media collage organized around a large central white rectangle, bordered by crumpled silver foil, paper fragments, concentric target rings, top-down warplane silhouettes, and compact discs. Handwritten text reads 'london', 'GUERNICA', '3dias', and 'WIN'; orange tape accents punctuate the lower register.
composition: central white void framed by collaged border
